title: Camera Firmware Skew Across Vendor
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=camera:health
| stats latest(firmware_version) as firmware_version by vendor camera
| eventstats dc(firmware_version) as firmware_variants by vendor
| where firmware_variants>1
| sort - firmware_variants
description: Uses Camera health inventory telemetry to monitor firmware skew inside each camera vendor fleet in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for uneven upgrade coverage that complicates incident response, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Camera health inventory data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Vendor inventory of camera firmware variants.
grandmaExplanation: It blends firmware skew inside each camera vendor fleet so you can spot uneven upgrade coverage that complicates incident response before it becomes annoying.
